rachel_cs: HorizonHealth flagged invoice INV-HZ-4102 \u2014 large burst line after an automatic failover to APAC standby on 2026-06-18. can billing review? :eyes:
owen_billing: quick meter check: reserved_commit=220k token-hrs, burst_used=102k token-hrs, burst_charge=$19,284 (rate $0.189/hr equiv). spike window 2026-06-18 01:05-05:20 UTC. logs show two rapid failover events.
sys-bot: incident recorded INC-APAC-8021, cause=spot eviction+autoscaler surge.
rachel_cs: customer says their consumer app couldn't warm gracefully; they request full waiver plus reversal of penalty.
mira_finance: SLA covers uptime; no explicit guidance on post-failover burst charges. we can do discretionary goodwill but need controls. amount looks material.
dylan_ae: HorizonHealth is in pilot and likely to expand. recommend a partial credit tied to postmortem and a one-time exception clause. propose 40% credit on burst ($7,713.60).
owen_billing: if approved I'll prepare credit memo but hold posting until CS confirms and postmortem is attached. ledger tag=GOODWILL_FAILOVER_CREDIT.
mira_finance: finance approves conditional credit: "Finance approves one-time goodwill credit of $7,713.60 for HorizonHealth (INV-HZ-4102), contingent on postmortem and customer acknowledgement." Need CS to collect customer ack and attach infra PM.
rachel_cs: I'll send offer to customer now, request written acceptance and note it's a one-time exception. PM ETA 72h. will update thread when customer replies. :email:
owen_billing: noted. will stage CreditMemo:-$7,713.60 pending confirmation. tagging @sys-bot for ledger note.
sys-bot: reminder: attach incident INC-APAC-8021 postmortem and reason code before month close.
mira_finance: once closed, finance will circulate a one-paragraph outcome for sales-ops.
rachel_cs: closing loop after postmortem + customer ack. :white_check_mark:
